name: The Ordinary Face & Hand Brightening Glow Kit | Complete Whitening & Hydrating Skincare Set
description:
Reveal your natural glow with The Ordinary Face & Hand Brightening Glow Kit, a 4-step skincare solution designed for radiant, even-toned skin. Infused with Niacinamide + Zinc and organic rice extract, this set deeply cleanses, exfoliates, hydrates, and brightens dull skin. Perfect for daily use, it helps reduce dark spots, smooth texture, and restore youthful radiance for both face and hands.Key Features:
 Cleanser removes impurities and refreshes skin
 Scrub exfoliates dead cells for smoother texture
 Mask brightens and nourishes for a radiant glow
 Serum hydrates and refines skin tone
 Paraben-free, sulfate-free, and suitable for all skin types
 Ideal for daily and weekly skincare routinesHow to Use:
1⃣ Apply cleanser to wet skin and massage gently, then rinse.
2⃣ Use scrub to exfoliate dead skin, then rinse clean.
3⃣ Apply mask evenly on face, leave for 15–20 minutes, then rinse.
4⃣ Finish with serum for hydration and glow.Ingredients:
Niacinamide, Zinc, Rice Extract, Aqua, Glycerin, Vitamin E, Natural Whitening AgentsSafety Information:
 For external use only.
 Avoid direct contact with eyes.
 Discontinue use if irritation occurs.
 Keep out of reach of children.

Package Includes:
 1 × Cleanser (120ml)
 1 × Scrub (120ml)
 1 × Mask (120ml)
 1 × Serum (30ml)
